steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition to ON/RUN with the engine off.
Press the DIC MENU button to reach the vehicle information screens, then scroll until REMAINING OIL LIFE shows.
Press and hold the SET/CLR button until the display reads 100%.
Turn the key to LOCK/OFF. The CHANGE ENGINE OIL SOON message should stay off at the next start.
oil.note: Checked in the 2010 and 2012 owner's manuals.

oil.when: 2010–2012 accelerator pedal method (no DIC buttons needed)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition to ON/RUN with the engine off.
Push the accelerator pedal all the way down and let it up, three times within five seconds.
Turn the key to LOCK/OFF, then start the engine. The reset worked if the CHANGE ENGINE OIL SOON message is gone; if not, repeat the steps.
oil.note: Checked in the 2010 and 2012 owner's manuals.

notes: Reset the oil life only after an oil change. The system does not reset itself, so it needs resetting every time, even after an early change.
